name: Build & Deploy (VPS)

# Pipeline multi-entorno para el monolito modular (PROCESS_TYPE=web|worker,
# ver MIGRATION_CONTEXT.md). Reemplaza el destino Azure Container Apps por un
# VPS Ubuntu de bajos recursos (2 vCPU / 1 GB RAM): se construye UNA imagen
# en GitHub Actions, se publica en Docker Hub, y el servidor solo hace
# `docker pull` + `docker compose up` — nunca compila nada localmente.
#
# Activación:
#   - push a `develop`            -> entorno staging
#   - push a `main`                -> entorno production
#   - release publicado sobre main -> entorno production
#   - workflow_dispatch manual     -> el usuario elige el entorno

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Entorno de destino"
        type: choice
        required: true
        options:
          - staging
          - production

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.event.inputs.environment || (github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging') }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resuelve una sola vez el entorno destino y el tag de imagen, para no
  # repetir el mismo condicional en cada job.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  setup:
    name: Resolve target environment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      environment: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.environment }}
      image_tag: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.image_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Resolve environment and image tag
        id: resolve
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" ]; then
            ENVIRONMENT="${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}"
          elif [ "${{ github.ref_name }}" = "main" ]; then
            ENVIRONMENT="production"
          else
            ENVIRONMENT="staging"
          fi
          SHORT_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          echo "environment=$ENVIRONMENT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "image_tag=sha-$SHORT_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Entorno resuelto: $ENVIRONMENT (tag: sha-$SHORT_SHA)"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build + push a Docker Hub. Corre bajo el Environment de GitHub del
  # entorno resuelto para heredar sus secrets/protecciones si se configuran.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    name: Build & push image
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push backend image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          build-args: |
            NODE_ENV=production
          tags: |
            ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/payrollback-v2:${{ needs.setup.outputs.image_tag }}
            ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/payrollback-v2:${{ needs.setup.outputs.environment }}-latest
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Despliegue en el VPS: sube el compose + .env del entorno, corre
  # migraciones en un contenedor descartable (si fallan, aborta sin tocar el
  # servicio en pie), reemplaza los contenedores, healthchecks y rollback
  # automático a la última imagen buena si el healthcheck no pasa.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to VPS
    needs: [setup, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.environment }}
    env:
      ENVIRONMENT: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.environment }}
      IMAGE_NAME: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/payrollback-v2
      IMAGE_TAG: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.image_tag }}
      DEPLOY_PATH: /opt/payroll/${{ needs.setup.outputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Ensure remote deploy directory exists
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SSH_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          port: ${{ secrets.SSH_PORT || 22 }}
          shell: bash
          envs: DEPLOY_PATH
          script: mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_PATH"

      - name: Upload runtime compose file
        uses: appleboy/scp-action@v0.1.7
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SSH_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          port: ${{ secrets.SSH_PORT || 22 }}
          source: "docker-compose.vps.yml"
          target: ${{ env.DEPLOY_PATH }}
          strip_components: 0
          overwrite: true

      - name: Write environment file on VPS
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        env:
          ENV_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.ENV_FILE }}
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SSH_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          port: ${{ secrets.SSH_PORT || 22 }}
          shell: bash
          envs: DEPLOY_PATH,ENV_CONTENT
          script: |
            set -euo pipefail
            umask 077
            printf '%s\n' "$ENV_CONTENT" > "$DEPLOY_PATH/.env.deploy"

      - name: Pull, migrate, deploy, healthcheck, rollback
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        env:
          IMAGE_NAME: ${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ env.ENVIRONMENT }}
          DEPLOY_PATH: ${{ env.DEPLOY_PATH }}
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SSH_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          port: ${{ secrets.SSH_PORT || 22 }}
          shell: bash
          envs: IMAGE_NAME,IMAGE_TAG,ENVIRONMENT,DEPLOY_PATH
          script: |
            set -euo pipefail
            cd "$DEPLOY_PATH"

            export IMAGE_NAME IMAGE_TAG ENVIRONMENT

            # ¿Este entorno usa RabbitMQ propio o mensajería externa (Azure Service Bus)?
            PROFILE_ARGS=""
            if grep -qE '^MESSAGING_PROVIDER=rabbitmq' .env.deploy; then
              PROFILE_ARGS="--profile rabbitmq"
            fi

            COMPOSE="docker compose -p payroll-$ENVIRONMENT $PROFILE_ARGS --env-file .env.deploy -f docker-compose.vps.yml"

            PREVIOUS_TAG="$(cat .last_good_tag 2>/dev/null || true)"
            echo "→ Desplegando $IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG en $ENVIRONMENT (anterior: ${PREVIOUS_TAG:-ninguno})"

            echo "→ [1/5] Pull de la nueva imagen"
            $COMPOSE pull

            echo "→ [2/5] Migraciones (contenedor descartable — el servicio actual sigue en pie)"
            if ! $COMPOSE run --rm -T --no-deps api npx typeorm migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js; then
              echo "✖ La migración falló — deploy abortado, el servicio actual NO fue tocado"
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "→ [3/5] Reemplazando contenedores"
            $COMPOSE up -d --remove-orphans

            echo "→ [4/5] Healthcheck (hasta 60s)"
            HEALTHY=false
            for i in $(seq 1 20); do
              if curl -fsS "http://localhost:3000/api/docs" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
                 && curl -fsS "http://localhost:3001/health" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"status":"ok"'; then
                HEALTHY=true
                break
              fi
              sleep 3
            done

            if [ "$HEALTHY" != "true" ]; then
              echo "✖ Healthcheck falló tras el despliegue"
              if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_TAG" ]; then
                echo "→ [5/5] Rollback automático a $PREVIOUS_TAG"
                IMAGE_TAG="$PREVIOUS_TAG" $COMPOSE up -d --remove-orphans
              else
                echo "✖ No hay tag previo registrado — no es posible hacer rollback automático"
              fi
              docker image prune -f
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "$IMAGE_TAG" > .last_good_tag
            echo "→ [5/5] Deploy exitoso — $IMAGE_TAG marcado como última versión buena"
            docker image prune -f
